title: Getting started with basemapper
Getting started with basemapper
text: Every rendering function takes style_input argument: either MapLibre GL style URL inline JSON string. helper functions build JSON common tile sources: Use list_layers() inspect style rendering:
code: library(basemapper)  # OpenStreetMap raster tiles osm_style <- raster_provider("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png")  # ArcGIS Online vector tile basemap esri_style <- esri_vector_provider(   "https://basemaps.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World_Basemap_v2/VectorTileServer" )  # Custom MVT source with paint overrides mvt_style <- vector_provider(   "https://example.com/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt",   paint = list("fill-color" = "#e8e0d8", "line-color" = "#aaaaaa") ) list_layers(osm_style)

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: geom_basemap() lazy ggproto layer: defers tile fetching coord_sf() established panel’s geographic extent, never compute bounding box manually. Key parameters shared across high-level functions:
code: library(ggplot2) library(sf)  nc <- st_read(system.file("shape/nc.shp", package = "sf"), quiet = TRUE)  ggplot(nc) +   geom_basemap(style_url = osm_style) +   geom_sf(fill = NA, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.4) +   coord_sf() +   theme_void()

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: tm_basemap() returns composable tmap v4 element. derives map extent pipeline’s primary shape bbox = NULL: Supply explicit bbox rendering outside tm_shape() pipeline:
code: library(tmap)  tm_shape(nc) +   tm_basemap(osm_style) +   tm_sf(fill = NA, col = "steelblue") tm_basemap(osm_style, bbox = st_bbox(nc))

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: Pass character vector layers keep specific layers, prefix IDs "-" exclude . Positive negative filters mixed.
code: # Keep only water and roads render_basemap_raw(   bbox_3857   = c(-13700000, 4500000, -13600000, 4600000),   width       = 512L,   height      = 512L,   style_input = osm_style,   layers      = c("water", "roads") )  # Exclude POI labels geom_basemap(style_url = osm_style, layers = c("-poi"))

title: Getting started with basemapper
text: render_basemap_raw() gives direct access pixel array custom compositing export:
code: m <- render_basemap_raw(   bbox_3857   = c(-13700000, 4500000, -13600000, 4600000),   width       = 800L,   height      = 600L,   style_input = osm_style )  # m is an integer array [height × width × 4] with spatial attrs dim(m)           # 600 800 4 attr(m, "xmin")  # -13700000 attr(m, "crs_epsg")  # 3857  # Save with png package png::writePNG(m / 255, "basemap.png")

title: R
text: basemapper headless spatial basemap renderer R. fetches composites styled map tiles (raster MapLibre GL vector styles) georeferenced RGBA arrays using Rust core, exposes result native integrations ggplot2, tmap v4, sf.

title: R
text: package compiles Rust extension installation. Install dependencies platform proceeding.

title: R
text: installation, open new terminal tools PATH, add Windows GNU target RTools45 uses:
code: # 1. RTools45 (compiler toolchain required by R on Windows) winget install RProject.Rtools  # 2. Rust toolchain manager winget install Rustlang.Rustup rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-gnu

title: R
text: macOS users also need Xcode Command Line Tools (xcode-select --install) already present.
code: # Rust toolchain manager (installs rustc and cargo) curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh
